card.name: Linking words before supportive-care drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "other", "with", "as" and "including" that come right before a named treatment drug class. Typical settings are steroids, immunosuppressants, G-CSF or antidiarrheals used to manage immune-mediated colitis or diarrhea in oncology labels.

modes.label: Required use of treatment
modes.description: "of" or "other" after wording like required use or coadministration, before steroids or immunosuppressants.

modes.label: Supportive care for side effects
modes.description: A linking word before antidiarrheals or growth factor in toxicity management advice.
modes.example: Start primary prophylaxis<< with>> G‑CSF beginning with Cycle

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the label names a rescue drug like steroids or antidiarrheals.
